title: Realization respects coefficient restriction and direct image
statement:
For finite commutative rings, the normalized realization/restriction and realization/direct-image maps commute with the sectionwise intrinsic coefficient/direct-image comparison.

theorem realizationRestrictionDirectImage
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (N : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B))) :
    (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y φ).map
        ((sfIntrinsicDirectImageComparison f B).hom.app N) ≫
      (sfRealizationRestriction Y φ).hom.app
        ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) f).obj N) =
    (proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageComparison f φ).hom.app
        ((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence X B).functor.obj N) ≫
      (proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage f A).map
        ((sfRealizationRestriction X φ).hom.app N) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicDirectImageComparison f A).hom.app
        ((sfFixedRestriction X φ).obj N)

proof.text: The sheafification unit on the fixed-module presheaf is an isomorphism because its underlying abelian presheaf is already a sheaf. Thus every section of the intrinsic realization is the unit image of a section m. The normalized realization/direct-image comparison takes that image to the realization unit of m after direct image. The normalized realization/restriction comparison does the same after restriction. The intrinsic coefficient/direct-image comparison is identity on sections. Substitute these normalization equations on each side; both sides equal the realization unit of m over the target site object. Extensionality on sections proves the equality.
